import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        String text = scanner.next();
        scanner.close();
        
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        boolean atDone = false;
        int len = text.length();
        
        for (int pos = 0; pos < len; ++pos) {
            if (pos > 0 && pos + 2 < len) {
                if (text.charAt(pos) == 'd' && text.charAt(pos+1) == 'o' && text.charAt(pos+2) == 't') {
                    result.append('.');
                    pos += 2;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            
            if (!atDone && pos > 0 && pos + 1 < len) {
                if (text.charAt(pos) == 'a' && text.charAt(pos+1) == 't') {
                    result.append('@');
                    pos += 1;
                    atDone = true;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            
            result.append(text.charAt(pos));
        }
        
        System.out.println(result.toString());
    }
}
